content.title: The Skeleton King
content.body:
§lHow To Summon The Skeleton King:
      §l1. §rHead to a desert.
      §l2. §rFind the §oDesert Tomb §r(Sandstone staircase that goes underground).
      §l3. §rFind the §oMimicrab §rwith the §o"King's Crown"§r.
      §l- §rAlternatively, take down the §oOsvermis §renemy for a chance of getting the crown.
      §l4. §rSearch for §oForsakens§r.
      §l5. §rSlain enough to acquire (6) §oShards of Reminiscence§r.
      §l6. §rCraft the §oCursed Crown§r.
      §l7. §rFind §oSkeleton Heads§r.
      §l8. §rPlace the head on the desert and give it the crown to start the fight.
